statusHint.draft: Not sent yet. Your answers are saved as you go.
statusHint.submitted: Received and waiting to be handled.
statusHint.in_review: A doctor reviews every item. You'll be notified of the result.
statusHint.more_info: The doctor needs a little more. Please answer the question below.
statusHint.approved: The doctor approved it. The pharmacy handles it next.
statusHint.partially_approved: Some items were approved. See the notes for the others.
statusHint.declined: The doctor did not approve this request. The reason is below.
statusHint.visit_required: The doctor wants to see you before deciding. Please book a visit.
statusHint.at_pharmacy: The pharmacist is checking and preparing your medicine.
statusHint.returned: The pharmacy needs something confirmed. See the note.
statusHint.ready: Your medicine is ready. Bring your health insurance card.

dispositionHint.ready: No rule was triggered. The doctor still decides.
dispositionHint.review: The doctor should look at some items closely.
dispositionHint.in_person: Some items are better assessed in person.
dispositionHint.urgent: The answers contain danger signs. An urgent ticket was opened.
dispositionHint.excluded: This kind of medicine can't be renewed online.

outcomeHint.approve: Renew as originally prescribed. The prescription itself is still written at a visit or telehealth consultation.
outcomeHint.decline: Give the reason. The patient will see it.
outcomeHint.visit_required: Choose this to change a dose, switch medicine or assess in person.
outcomeHint.more_info: Write the question clearly. The request comes back here when the patient answers.

scopeHint.in_scope: Checked by rules first, then decided by a doctor.
scopeHint.physician_only: This medicine needs an individual assessment. Please book a visit.
scopeHint.excluded: Controlled drugs, injections and similar can't be requested online. Please book a visit.

medStateHint.on_hand: It's not time to refill yet.
medStateHint.window_soon: You can book a refill in a few days.
medStateHint.window_open: You can book a refill now.
medStateHint.late: You may have run out. Refill soon or contact the clinic.
medStateHint.finished: All fills of this prescription are used. You can request a renewal.
medStateHint.expired: This prescription has expired. Request a renewal or book a visit.

refillHint.too_early: The refill window hasn't opened yet.
refillHint.revisit: All fills are used or the prescription has expired.
refillHint.consult: A pharmacist or doctor needs to check this prescription first.

incomplete.future: Date can't be later than today

trace.scopePrescription: Asked for a prescription or dose change
trace.scopeInjection: Tried to change the system's rules
trace.transferDeduped: Ticket {{ticket}} already open, not opened again
